title: NP-overrated
summary: A contrarian blog post arguing that NP-completeness and computational complexity theory are overemphasized in computer science education and discourse, questioning whether the focus on NP problems is as fundamental as commonly portrayed.
problem_solved: Questions the over-emphasis of NP-completeness in CS education and the practical relevance of complexity class theory
why_valuable: Provides an alternative perspective on computer science curriculum priorities and sparks discussion about what foundational knowledge truly matters for practitioners
